''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

The Wheel of Time translates as ''Roata Timpului'' in Romanian. The series has been published by Editura RAO in recent years with A Memory of Light being published in 2024. No translation of New Spring has yet been made.

The translators for the Romanian versions so far are Cezar Octavian Tăbârcea, Diana Lupu,  Cristina-Mihaela Tripon, Dorian Botezatu, Petru Iamandi, Marius Motoca, Sebastian Bican and Sandra-Iulia Ronai,
